submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Turn image 1 into a genuinely GROUNDED MID-STANCE RUN SW frame 09 of the same fire-talisman BOY. Images 2–3 lock his identity and southwest view; image 4 is the approved rendering style; image 5 is ONLY a reference for a support foot directly beneath a loaded pelvis. Do not borrow the girl, bow or clothes.
Keep camera, whole-canvas composition and physical head/body size. Keep the existing face, ponytail, red-gold costume and exact two arm chains: near LEFT arm forward holding bronze bell, far RIGHT arm behind holding exactly FIVE red cards.
Change the running legs and their load path clearly. The anatomical RIGHT/far leg bears ALL the weight. In image 1 its shoe reaches too far ahead of the hips; redraw this planted right shoe farther BACK along the virtual ground toward the body, directly under the pelvis. The sole remains flat and grounded, toe still toward lower-left/SW. The right knee stays softly bent, directly above the same ankle/second toe travel axis. Redraw the pelvis and lower torso advanced over this supporting ankle so one can trace a compact vertical load path from belly through right hip and bent knee into planted shoe. This is a single-legged supported body, NOT a long split-legged leap with a flattened shoe.
The anatomical LEFT/near leg is the free leg: lift and fold its knee beneath/behind the near hip, heel tucked upward, shoe OFF ground, beginning its forward passing swing but never replacing the right support leg. No extra legs, no inward knot or outward-foot roll.
Preserve right-fan/left-bell grip and identity. Do not simply lower or shrink the entire cutout. No global zoom, ground drawing, baked shadow or effects. One transparent RGBA full square sprite, native >=1024.
